name: Wolfstar: Sins and Paradise
source:
Lost to a mysterious city of sin, this visual novel will explore and focus primarily on the choices our hero Wolfstar makes in his new afterlife (...). Players also have to balance out the limited amount of monetary/sexual resources in their afterlife as the dark entity known only as, the Tax Man, comes to collect at the end of every month cycle. Having little to no sexual encounters comes with a cost, as the Tax Man has imposed sexual quotas to all citizens living in his city. Players can of course make up the difference by paying cash to the Tax Man, but that means spending more time at work as a stripper to pay off those debts–and a stripper's job is not without its share of dangerous encounters Choose wisely who you want to spend your afterlife with, as there are no second chances just like real life on any given day.

[From [url=https://hyperwolfstar.itch.io/wolfstar-sins-and-paradise]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这部视觉小说迷失在一座神秘的罪恶之城，将探索并主要关注我们的英雄狼星在他新的来世中所做的选择（…）。玩家还必须在来世平衡有限的金钱/性资源，因为黑暗实体（仅称为税务员）会在每个月周期结束时收集。很少甚至没有性接触是有代价的，因为税务员对居住在他城市的所有公民实行了性配额。玩家当然可以通过向税务员支付现金来弥补差额，但这意味着要花更多的时间作为脱衣舞娘来偿还这些债务——而脱衣舞娘的工作并非没有危险的遭遇。明智地选择你想和谁共度来世，因为就像现实生活中的任何一天一样，没有第二次机会。

[来自[url=https://hyperwolfstar.itch.io/wolfstar-sins-and-paradise]Itch.io[/url]]
